name: agent-playbook
description: Personal playbooks for working with AI agents: a shared knowledge-base core plus domain playbooks (software development, personal life).

plugins.name: kb
plugins.description: Knowledge-base core used by every playbook: capture, ideas and brainstorm, triage, stash/unstash, ingest, lint.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Software development playbook: project .ai/ knowledge base, task lifecycle from spec to close, park/resume.

plugins.name: me
plugins.description: Personal knowledge vault: save recipes, how-tos, prompts and answers from conversations as Markdown notes; find them later. Obsidian as the UI.

plugins.name: code-graph
plugins.description: Code graph across all repositories of a project (cross-repo-graph MCP server): callers, cross-repo HTTP/config/package links with file:line, re-indexed at session start. Enabled per project by /dev:init-project.
